methodology: World-native spatial adapters for currently indexed digital property. The adapter describes how to read coordinates from canonical market-snapshot records; it does not duplicate mutable listing prices or invent a universal metaverse coordinate system.

worlds.name: The Sandbox
worlds.truthNote: Viewport is fitted to the indexed Realty observations, not presented as a complete official world map.

worlds.name: Decentraland
worlds.truthNote: Only parcels with explicit coordinate-bearing Realty records are plotted.

worlds.name: Otherside
worlds.truthNote: The current Realty source contract has Otherdeed identity and market context but no admitted x/y spatial coordinate for plotting.

worlds.name: Somnium Space
worlds.truthNote: The current Realty source contract has parcel identity and market context but no admitted map coordinate.

worlds.name: Voxels
worlds.truthNote: Market family is tracked, while listing and spatial ingestion are still pending.
